name: Landon Woolley
source:
“Maya made this herself?! Ahh, even if this was my very last meal I could die happy!”

A cadet in the Wings of Garuda.
Though his careless air and penchant for laziness make him seem ill-fit for the work of a knight at first glance, he's incredibly nimble and has even quicker reflexes.
He nurses feelings for Maya, but because she continues to brush him off he's yet to succeed at inviting her on a date.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/tempest/english/characters/?page=landon]the official site[/url]]
